extension.description: Utilities for an Amlogic CoreELEC + Android internal dual-boot: sync Bluetooth remotes paired in Android over to CoreELEC (no re-pairing), choose which OS boots by default, and fix the WiFi MAC if CoreELEC shows a wrong/shared default. Generic to Amlogic CoreELEC boxes.
extension.news:
v1.0.1 - Bluetooth sync: adopt Android's BLE identity (local IRK + privacy), not just the device bonds, so remotes paired in Android actually reconnect in CoreELEC. - Bluetooth sync: stop bluetoothd before writing its store, and make sure the adapter comes back powered afterwards (a restart could leave the controller off, i.e. "no Bluetooth adapter").
v1.0.0 - Initial release: Bluetooth remote sync from Android, default boot OS, WiFi MAC fix.
